- Key constraints: PHI handling, region = US, regular audit reporting.

Next step: 30-minute product intro (high-level demo + 10 minutes for Q&A). I suggest we keep this to a short, focused session for the immediate stakeholders; we can schedule a later technical deep-dive with engineers.

Proposed 3 windows (all PST):
1) Tuesday, Feb 2 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Tuesday, Feb 2 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Wednesday, Feb 3 — 11:30–12:00 PM PT

Please reply with your preferred slot (1/2/3) or propose an alternate time; if you want additional internal attendees added, note their names and we will invite the right people on our side.

Attached: skyline-summary-deck.pdf (2 slides), and a short demo agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.md).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
